# Link and spelling check

*Reviewer · the new pages in pages/*

## Needs fixing (most important first)

1. **pages/about.md, line 14** — "meet the team" links to the old site's address
   (`fernhill-old.example/people`). It should go to `/team`.
2. **pages/about.md, line 22** — "get in touch" links to the old contact form (`fernhill-old.example/contact-us`).
   It should go to `/contact`.
3. **pages/services.md, line 9** — "recieve" should be "receive".

## Worth a look

- **pages/home.md** — the contact section has two versions, a form and an email address. Only one should go live.
- **pages/team.md** — Kai's photo has no description for screen readers.

## Passes

- Every other link on the eight pages goes to a page that exists.
- Spelling on home, work, team, contact, privacy and terms.
- Each page has a title and a one-line description.

Both broken links go away for anyone with an old bookmark once the redirects are set up (WEB-6).
